s.t: A king had 12 daughters.
s.fr: Un roi avait 12 filles.

s.t: All 12 were princesses.
s.fr: Les 12 étaient des princesses.

s.t: The princesses shared one room.
s.fr: Les princesses partageaient une chambre.

s.t: Every night, the king locked their door himself.
s.fr: Chaque nuit, le roi fermait leur porte à clé lui-même.

s.t: He kept the only key.
s.fr: Il gardait la seule clé.

paras.summary: A king has 12 daughters, all princesses, who share one large room; every night the king locks their door himself and keeps the only key.

s.t: Every morning, the princesses' shoes were danced to pieces.
s.fr: Chaque matin, les chaussures des princesses étaient usées à force de danser.

s.t: No one saw the princesses leave the locked room.
s.fr: Personne ne vit les princesses quitter la chambre fermée à clé.

s.t: New shoes were brought, but they were danced to pieces too.
s.fr: De nouvelles chaussures furent apportées, mais elles furent aussi usées à force de danser.

s.t: This happened again and again, for many months.
s.fr: Cela arriva encore et encore, pendant de nombreux mois.

paras.summary: Even so, the princesses' shoes are found danced to pieces every morning, though no one ever sees them leave or return; new shoes are brought, but they are danced to pieces too, again and again, for many months.

s.t: The king asked his daughters where they went.
s.fr: Le roi demanda à ses filles où elles allaient.

s.t: "We were asleep all night," said the eldest princess.
s.fr: « Nous avons dormi toute la nuit, » dit-elle, la princesse aînée.

s.t: The other princesses said nothing at all.
s.fr: Les autres princesses ne dirent rien du tout.

s.t: The king never solved this mystery.
s.fr: Le roi ne résolut jamais ce mystère.

paras.summary: The king asks his daughters where they went, but the eldest only says they were asleep, and the other princesses say nothing at all; every night the shoes are danced to pieces again, and the king never solves this mystery.

s.t: The king wanted to solve this mystery.
s.fr: Le roi voulait résoudre ce mystère.

s.t: He made an offer to any man in the kingdom.
s.fr: Il fit une offre à tout homme du royaume.

s.t: Any man could try to solve the mystery.
s.fr: Tout homme pouvait essayer de résoudre le mystère.

s.t: He would watch the princesses for 3 nights.
s.fr: Il surveillerait les princesses pendant 3 nuits.

paras.summary: The king wants to solve the mystery of his daughters and makes an offer to any man in the kingdom, though the princesses say nothing about it; any man may try, watching the princesses for 3 nights.

s.t: If he learned the mystery, he could marry one of the 12 princesses.
s.fr: S’il découvrait le mystère, il pourrait épouser l’une des 12 princesses.

s.t: The winning man would also rule the kingdom one day.
s.fr: L’homme gagnant régnerait aussi sur le royaume un jour.

s.t: But if he failed, he would be sent away from the kingdom forever.
s.fr: Mais s’il échouait, il serait renvoyé du royaume pour toujours.

s.t: Even so, many princes wanted to try.
s.fr: Même ainsi, beaucoup de princes voulaient essayer.

s.t: No prince had solved the mystery before.
s.fr: Aucun prince n’avait résolu le mystère avant.

paras.summary: A prince who learns the mystery may marry one of the 12 princesses and one day rule the kingdom, but a prince who fails will be sent away from the kingdom forever; even so, many princes want to try, though no prince has ever solved it before.

s.t: Prince after prince came to the castle to try.
s.fr: Prince après prince vint au château pour essayer.

s.t: Each prince had a room by the princesses' door.
s.fr: Chaque prince avait une chambre près de la porte des princesses.

s.t: He could watch the princesses' door all night.
s.fr: Il pouvait surveiller la porte des princesses toute la nuit.

s.t: Each morning, the king asked the prince what he had seen.
s.fr: Chaque matin, le roi demanda au prince ce qu’il avait vu.

paras.summary: Prince after prince comes to the castle to try and is given a room by the princesses' door to watch all night; each morning the king asks what the prince saw, and each still hopes he will be the one to solve the mystery.

s.t: The first prince came to watch the princesses.
s.fr: Le premier prince vint surveiller les princesses.

s.t: The eldest princess brought him wine in the evening.
s.fr: La princesse aînée lui apporta du vin le soir.

s.t: The wine had a sleeping drink in it.
s.fr: Le vin contenait une boisson soporifique.

s.t: He drank all the wine and was asleep.
s.fr: Il but tout le vin et s’endormit.

paras.summary: The first prince comes to watch the princesses, and the eldest princess brings him wine in the evening with a sleeping drink in it; he drinks all of it and is soon asleep all night, seeing nothing.

s.t: He was asleep all night and saw nothing.
s.fr: Il dormit toute la nuit et ne vit rien.

s.t: Every morning, the princesses' shoes were danced to pieces again.
s.fr: Chaque matin, les souliers des princesses étaient de nouveau usés à force de danser.

s.t: "What did you see?" the king asked.
s.fr: « Qu’avez-vous vu ? » demanda le roi.

s.t: "Nothing," said the prince.
s.fr: « Rien, » dit le prince.

paras.summary: Every morning the princesses' shoes are danced to pieces again, and when the king asks what the prince saw, the prince says nothing.

s.t: The same happened on the second night.
s.fr: La même chose arriva la deuxième nuit.

s.t: The same happened on the third night.
s.fr: La même chose arriva la troisième nuit.

s.t: The prince never saw the princesses leave or return.
s.fr: Le prince ne vit jamais les princesses partir ou revenir.

s.t: He had failed to solve the mystery.
s.fr: Il avait échoué à résoudre le mystère.

s.t: The king sent him away from the kingdom forever.
s.fr: Le roi le renvoya du royaume pour toujours.

paras.summary: The same happens on the second night and again on the third, and the prince never sees the princesses leave or return; having failed to solve the mystery, he is sent away from the kingdom forever.

s.t: More princes came to try.
s.fr: D’autres princes vinrent pour essayer.

s.t: Each prince watched the princesses for 3 nights.
s.fr: Chaque prince surveilla les princesses pendant 3 nuits.

s.t: In the evening, he drank the wine.
s.fr: Le soir, il but le vin.

s.t: Each prince was asleep all night and saw nothing at all.
s.fr: Chaque prince dormit toute la nuit et ne vit rien du tout.

s.t: One prince tried to stay awake.
s.fr: Un prince essaya de rester éveillé.

paras.summary: More princes come to try, each watching the princesses for 3 nights and drinking the wine in the evening, then falling asleep to see nothing at all; one prince tries to stay awake instead.

s.t: But he too drank the wine and was soon asleep.
s.fr: Mais lui aussi but le vin et s’endormit bientôt.

s.t: Prince after prince failed.
s.fr: Prince après prince échoua.

s.t: The king sent each one away from the kingdom forever.
s.fr: Le roi renvoya chacun loin du royaume pour toujours.

s.t: Years passed, and still no prince solved the mystery.
s.fr: Les années passèrent, et toujours aucun prince ne résolut le mystère.

paras.summary: But he too drinks the wine and is soon asleep, and prince after prince fails, sent away from the kingdom forever by the king; years pass, and still no prince solves the mystery.

s.t: Word of the mystery spread to other lands.
s.fr: La nouvelle du mystère se répandit dans d’autres terres.

s.t: Fewer and fewer princes came to try.
s.fr: De moins en moins de princes vinrent essayer.

s.t: At last, no more princes came at all.
s.fr: Finalement, plus aucun prince ne vint du tout.

s.t: The king began to lose all hope.
s.fr: Le roi commença à perdre tout espoir.

paras.summary: Word of the mystery spreads to other lands, but fewer and fewer princes come to try, until at last no more princes come at all, and the king begins to lose all hope.

chapterList.title: The Wounded Soldier
also: The Old Woman in the Woods

s.t: An old soldier walked home.
s.fr: Un vieux soldat rentrait chez lui à pied.

s.t: He had been wounded.
s.fr: Il avait été blessé.

s.t: The soldier had little money.
s.fr: Le soldat avait peu d’argent.

s.t: The soldier learned of the king's offer.
s.fr: Le soldat apprit l’offre du roi.

paras.summary: An old soldier walks home, wounded and with little money, until he learns of the king's offer; many others had failed.

s.t: Any man could try to solve the mystery of the princesses.
s.fr: N’importe quel homme pouvait essayer de résoudre le mystère des princesses.

s.t: If he learned it, he could marry a princess.
s.fr: S’il l’apprenait, il pouvait épouser une princesse.

s.t: If he failed, he would be sent away from the kingdom forever.
s.fr: S’il échouait, il serait chassé du royaume pour toujours.

s.t: He had little hope, too.
s.fr: Il avait peu d’espoir, lui aussi.

paras.summary: Any man could try to solve the mystery of the princesses and marry one if he learns it, but he would be sent away from the kingdom forever if he fails; the soldier has little hope, too.

s.t: But he still wanted to try.
s.fr: Mais il voulait quand même essayer.

s.t: "I will try," said the soldier.
s.fr: « Je vais essayer », dit le soldat.

s.t: The soldier walked to the king's castle.
s.fr: Le soldat marcha jusqu’au château du roi.

s.t: He knew the princesses' shoes were danced to pieces.
s.fr: Il savait que les chaussures des princesses étaient usées à force de danser.

s.t: He walked through a forest.
s.fr: Il traversa une forêt.

paras.summary: But he still wants to try, and he says he will try; he walks to the king's castle knowing the princesses' shoes are danced to pieces, then walks on through a forest.

s.t: The soldier saw an old woman.
s.fr: Le soldat vit une vieille femme.

s.t: "Where do you go?" the old woman asked.
s.fr: « Où allez-vous ? » demanda la vieille femme.

s.t: "I go to try to solve the mystery," said the soldier.
s.fr: « Je vais essayer de résoudre le mystère, » dit le soldat.

s.t: "Many have failed," said the old woman.
s.fr: « Beaucoup ont échoué, » dit la vieille femme.

paras.summary: The soldier sees an old woman, who asks where he is going; he says he is going to try to solve the king's mystery, and she warns him that many have failed.

s.t: "Do not drink the wine they bring you at night."
s.fr: « Ne buvez pas le vin qu’ils vous apportent la nuit. »

s.t: "Pretend to sleep."
s.fr: « Faites semblant de dormir. »

s.t: She had a cloak.
s.fr: Elle avait un manteau.

s.t: "This cloak will make you invisible," she said.
s.fr: « Ce manteau vous rendra invisible, » dit-elle.

s.t: "But others can still hear you," she said.
s.fr: « Mais les autres peuvent encore vous entendre, » dit-elle.

paras.summary: She tells him not to drink the wine they bring him at night, and to pretend to sleep; she has a cloak for him that she says will make him invisible, though others can still hear him.

s.t: The soldier thanked her.
s.fr: Le soldat la remercia.

s.t: He walked on to the king's castle.
s.fr: Il continua sa route vers le château du roi.

s.t: He told the king he still wanted to try.
s.fr: Il dit au roi qu’il voulait encore essayer.

s.t: The king said he could try, too.
s.fr: Le roi dit qu’il pouvait aussi essayer.

paras.summary: The soldier thanks her and walks on to the king's castle, where he tells the king he still wants to try, and the king says he could try, too.

s.t: The soldier was in the king's castle.
s.fr: Le soldat était dans le château du roi.

s.t: In the evening, the eldest princess brought him wine.
s.fr: Le soir, la princesse aînée lui apporta du vin.

s.t: He knew not to drink the wine.
s.fr: Il savait qu’il ne fallait pas boire le vin.

s.t: He poured the wine away, unseen.
s.fr: Il versa le vin, sans être vu.

paras.summary: The soldier is in the king's castle, having come to solve the mystery though he would be sent away if he failed; in the evening the eldest princess brings him wine, but he knows not to drink it, so he pours it away, unseen.

s.t: He pretended to sleep.
s.fr: Il fit semblant de dormir.

s.t: He snored.
s.fr: Il ronfla.

s.t: The eldest princess listened at his door.
s.fr: La princesse aînée écouta à sa porte.

s.t: "He sleeps," she said.
s.fr: « Il dort », dit-elle.

s.t: The 12 princesses put on dresses.
s.fr: Les 12 princesses mirent des robes.

s.t: The eldest princess opened a trapdoor.
s.fr: La princesse aînée ouvrit une trappe.

s.t: One by one, the princesses went down the stairs.
s.fr: Une par une, les princesses descendirent les escaliers.

paras.summary: He pretends to sleep and snores, and the eldest princess listens at his door and decides he sleeps, so the 12 princesses put on dresses, and the eldest opens a trapdoor, through which they go down the stairs one by one.

s.t: The soldier put on the cloak, opened the door, and followed them.
s.fr: Le soldat mit le manteau, ouvrit la porte, et les suivit.

s.t: On the stairs, he stepped on the youngest princess's dress.
s.fr: Dans l’escalier, il marcha sur la robe de la plus jeune princesse.

s.t: "Someone stepped on my dress!" she said.
s.fr: « Quelqu’un a marché sur ma robe ! » dit-elle.

s.t: "It was nothing," said the eldest.
s.fr: « Ce n’était rien, » dit l’aînée.

s.t: They walked on down the stairs.
s.fr: Elles continuèrent à descendre l’escalier.

paras.summary: The soldier puts on the cloak, opens the door, and follows them, but on the stairs he steps on the youngest princess's dress; she says someone stepped on it, though the eldest says it was nothing, and they walk on down the stairs.

s.t: The stairs went down to a path.
s.fr: L’escalier descendait vers un chemin.

s.t: The path had silver trees.
s.fr: Le chemin avait des arbres argentés.

s.t: The soldier followed the princesses down the path.
s.fr: Le soldat suivit les princesses le long du chemin.

s.t: He broke a branch from a tree.
s.fr: Il cassa une branche d’un arbre.

s.t: It cracked.
s.fr: Elle craqua.

paras.summary: The stairs go down to a path with silver trees standing by it, and the soldier, following the princesses down the path, breaks a branch from a tree, which cracks.

s.t: The youngest princess was startled.
s.fr: La plus jeune princesse sursauta.

s.t: "Did you hear that?" she asked.
s.fr: « Avez-vous entendu cela ? » demanda-t-elle.

s.t: "That was only an owl," said the eldest.
s.fr: « C’était seulement une chouette », dit l’aînée.

s.t: The youngest princess said nothing more.
s.fr: La plus jeune princesse ne dit plus rien.

paras.summary: The youngest princess is startled and asks if her sisters heard that, but the eldest says it was only an owl, so the youngest says nothing more.

s.t: They walked on down the path.
s.fr: Ils continuèrent à marcher sur le chemin.

s.t: No one in the castle knew where the princesses went at night.
s.fr: Personne dans le château ne savait où les princesses allaient la nuit.

s.t: But the soldier knew the mystery.
s.fr: Mais le soldat connaissait le mystère.

s.t: He still had 2 more nights to watch.
s.fr: Il avait encore 2 nuits à surveiller.

paras.summary: They walk on down the path, and though no one in the castle knew where the princesses went at night, the soldier knows the mystery, with 2 more nights still to watch.

s.t: The princesses walked by trees of gold and trees of diamond.
s.fr: Les princesses passèrent devant des arbres d’or et des arbres de diamant.

s.t: At last, they came to a lake.
s.fr: Enfin, ils arrivèrent à un lac.

s.t: 12 boats were at the lake.
s.fr: 12 bateaux étaient au lac.

s.t: Each boat had a prince in it.
s.fr: Chaque bateau avait un prince à bord.

paras.summary: The princesses walk by trees of gold and trees of diamond and at last come to a lake, where 12 boats wait, each with a prince in it.

s.t: The soldier was in the youngest princess's boat.
s.fr: Le soldat était dans le bateau de la plus jeune princesse.

s.t: "This boat feels heavy," said her prince.
s.fr: « Ce bateau semble lourd », dit son prince.

s.t: "It was only the warm night," said the youngest princess.
s.fr: « C’était seulement la nuit chaude ,» dit la plus jeune princesse.

s.t: The boats came to a castle.
s.fr: Les bateaux arrivèrent à un château.

paras.summary: The soldier is in the youngest princess's boat, and her prince says the boat feels heavy, but she says it was only the warm night, as the boats come to a castle.

s.t: At the castle, the princesses danced with the princes.
s.fr: Au château, les princesses dansèrent avec les princes.

s.t: Their shoes were danced to pieces again.
s.fr: Leurs chaussures furent de nouveau dansées en morceaux.

s.t: Before morning, they returned to their room.
s.fr: Avant le matin, elles retournèrent dans leur chambre.

s.t: The soldier returned to his room, too.
s.fr: Le soldat retourna dans sa chambre aussi.

paras.summary: At the castle, the princesses dance with the princes until their shoes are danced to pieces again, and before morning they return to their room, the soldier returning to his room, too.

s.t: The first night was over.
s.fr: La première nuit était terminée.

paras.summary: The king still knows nothing of the mystery; the first night is over.

s.t: On the second night, the soldier followed the same steps.
s.fr: La deuxième nuit, le soldat suivit les mêmes étapes.

s.t: The path had gold trees this time.
s.fr: Le chemin avait des arbres d’or cette fois.

s.t: He broke a branch of gold, and it cracked.
s.fr: Il cassa une branche d’or, et elle craqua.

s.t: The youngest princess was startled again, and grew more afraid.
s.fr: La plus jeune princesse fut de nouveau surprise, et devint plus effrayée.

paras.summary: On the second night, the soldier follows the same steps, and this time the path has gold trees; he breaks a branch of gold, which cracks and startles the youngest princess again, growing more afraid.

s.t: "Sister, I heard it again," she said.
s.fr: « Sœur, je l’ai encore entendu, » dit-elle.

s.t: "That was only the wind," said the eldest.
s.fr: « C’était seulement le vent, » dit l’aînée.

s.t: They danced at the castle until their shoes were danced to pieces.
s.fr: Ils dansèrent au château jusqu’à ce que leurs chaussures soient réduites en morceaux.

s.t: He hid the branch under his cloak.
s.fr: Il cacha la branche sous son manteau.

paras.summary: "Sister, I heard it again," she says, but the eldest says it was only the wind, and they dance at the castle until their shoes are danced to pieces; the soldier hides the branch under his cloak.

s.t: This time, the path had diamond trees.
s.fr: Cette fois, le chemin avait des arbres de diamant.

s.t: He broke a branch of diamond, and it cracked in his hand.
s.fr: Il cassa une branche de diamant, et elle craqua dans sa main.

s.t: The youngest princess was startled a third time, and felt even more afraid.
s.fr: La plus jeune princesse fut surprise une troisième fois, et se sentit encore plus effrayée.

s.t: "I know I heard something," she said.
s.fr: « Je sais que j’ai entendu quelque chose, » dit-elle.

s.t: "That was only a stone," said the eldest.
s.fr: « C’était seulement une pierre, » dit l’aînée.

paras.summary: By the third night, only 1 more was left, and this time the path has diamond trees; he breaks a branch of diamond, which cracks in his hand and startles the youngest princess a third time, feeling even more afraid, but she says she knows she heard something, and the eldest says it was only a stone.

s.t: At the castle, the soldier took a cup of gold.
s.fr: Au château, le soldat prit une coupe d’or.

s.t: He hid the cup and the branches under his cloak.
s.fr: Il cacha la coupe et les branches sous son manteau.

paras.summary: At the castle, the soldier takes a cup of gold, and the princesses' shoes are danced to pieces once more; he hides the cup and the branches under his cloak, and now has 3 branches and a cup of gold.

s.t: In the morning, the king asked the soldier what he had seen.
s.fr: Le matin, le roi demanda au soldat ce qu’il avait vu.

s.t: "I did not drink the wine," said the soldier.
s.fr: « Je n’ai pas bu le vin, » dit le soldat.

s.t: "I followed the princesses through a trapdoor."
s.fr: « J’ai suivi les princesses par une trappe. »

s.t: "We walked down a path with trees of silver, gold, and diamond."
s.fr: « Nous avons marché le long d’un chemin avec des arbres d’argent, d’or et de diamant. »

paras.summary: In the morning, the king asks the soldier what he saw, and the soldier says he did not drink the wine but followed the princesses through a trapdoor, down a path with trees of silver, gold, and diamond.

s.t: "Then we came to a lake with 12 boats."
s.fr: « Puis nous sommes arrivés à un lac avec 12 bateaux. »

s.t: "The boats went to a castle, where the princesses danced."
s.fr: « Les bateaux allèrent à un château, où les princesses dansèrent. »

s.t: "They danced until their shoes were danced to pieces," said the soldier.
s.fr: « Elles dansèrent jusqu’à ce que leurs chaussures soient usées, » dit le soldat.

paras.summary: Then they came to a lake with 12 boats, and the boats went to a castle, where the princesses danced until their shoes were danced to pieces.

s.t: The soldier showed the king 3 branches.
s.fr: Le soldat montra au roi 3 branches.

s.t: "One is silver, one is gold, and one is diamond," he said.
s.fr: « L’une est en argent, une en or, et une en diamant, » dit-il.

s.t: He also showed the king a cup of gold.
s.fr: Il montra aussi au roi une coupe d’or.

s.t: The king had never seen such proof.
s.fr: Le roi n’avait jamais vu une telle preuve.

s.t: "Bring my daughters to me," said the king.
s.fr: « Amenez mes filles à moi, » dit le roi.

s.t: The 12 princesses came before the king.
s.fr: Les 12 princesses vinrent devant le roi.

paras.summary: The soldier shows the king 3 branches, one of silver, one of gold, and one of diamond, and also a cup of gold; the king has never seen such proof, so he calls for his daughters to be brought to him, and the 12 princesses come before the king.

s.t: The king looked at his 12 princesses.
s.fr: Le roi regarda ses 12 princesses.

s.t: He showed them the branches and the cup.
s.fr: Il leur montra les branches et la coupe.

s.t: "What is this?" he asked.
s.fr: « Qu’est-ce que ceci ? » demanda-t-il.

s.t: The princesses said nothing.
s.fr: Les princesses ne dirent rien.

paras.summary: The king looks at his 12 princesses and shows them the branches and the cup, asking what this is, but the princesses say nothing.

s.t: At last, the eldest princess said, "A spell binds us."
s.fr: Enfin, la princesse aînée dit, « Un sort nous lie. »

s.t: "Every night, we must go to a castle," she said.
s.fr: « Chaque nuit, nous devons aller à un château, » dit-elle.

s.t: "We used the trapdoor," she said.
s.fr: « Nous avons utilisé la trappe, » dit-elle.

s.t: "We dance with 12 princes until morning," she said.
s.fr: « Nous dansons avec 12 princes jusqu’au matin, » dit-elle.

s.t: "We could not tell," she said.
s.fr: « Nous ne pouvions pas le dire, » dit-elle.

paras.summary: At last, the eldest princess says a spell binds them, and every night they must go to a castle, using the trapdoor to dance with 12 princes until morning; they could not tell him.

s.t: The youngest princess said nothing.
s.fr: La plus jeune princesse ne dit rien.

s.t: The other princesses agreed.
s.fr: Les autres princesses étaient d’accord.

s.t: The king remembered the locked door every night.
s.fr: Le roi se souvenait de la porte verrouillée chaque nuit.

s.t: Now the king knew why.
s.fr: Maintenant le roi savait pourquoi.

paras.summary: The youngest princess says nothing, and the other princesses agree; the king, remembering the locked door every night, now knows why.

s.t: The king looked at the soldier.
s.fr: Le roi regarda le soldat.

s.t: "Choose one of my daughters," said the king.
s.fr: « Choisissez une de mes filles, » dit le roi.

s.t: The soldier looked at the 12 princesses.
s.fr: Le soldat regarda les 12 princesses.

s.t: "I choose the eldest," said the soldier.
s.fr: « Je choisis l’aînée, » dit le soldat.

s.t: "I am no longer young," he said.
s.fr: « Je ne suis plus jeune, » dit-il.

s.t: The eldest princess smiled at him.
s.fr: L’aînée des princesses lui sourit.

paras.summary: The king looks at the soldier and tells him to choose one of his daughters, so the soldier looks at the 12 princesses and chooses the eldest, saying he is no longer young; the eldest princess smiles at him.

s.t: That night, the spell broke.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, le sort se brisa.

s.t: That castle closed forever.
s.fr: Ce château se ferma pour toujours.

s.t: The 12 princes were free.
s.fr: Les 12 princes étaient libres.

s.t: The soldier and the eldest princess were married.
s.fr: Le soldat et la princesse aînée étaient mariés.

s.t: All the people came to see the wedding.
s.fr: Tout le peuple vint voir le mariage.

paras.summary: That night, the spell breaks, and that castle closes forever, freeing the 12 princes; the soldier and the eldest princess are married, and all the people come to see the wedding.

s.t: The soldier had a home in the castle now.
s.fr: Le soldat avait maintenant un foyer dans le château.

s.t: No more shoes were danced to pieces.
s.fr: Plus aucune chaussure ne fut usée en dansant.

paras.summary: The soldier has a home in the castle now, and no more shoes are danced to pieces.
